assets.alt: Lateral view of raccoon dog skull specimen SPEC-0001 with the cranium and mandibles in occlusion.
Oblique view of raccoon dog skull specimen SPEC-0001 showing a small chip at the anterior nasal tip.
Frontal view of raccoon dog skull specimen SPEC-0001 showing the orbits, dentition, and small chip at the rostral tip.
